title: Interactive Coding: String Concatenation
subtitle: Combining Words with Operator +
description: Practice joining strings across 2 interactive stages!
starter_code:
first_name = "Alan"
last_name = "Turing"
# Stage 1: Combine with a space

challenges.title: Stage 1: Full Name Construction
challenges.description: Join <hlt>first_name</hlt> and <hlt>last_name</hlt> with a space: <hlt>full_name = first_name + " " + last_name</hlt> and print.
challenges.starter_code:
first_name = "Alan"
last_name = "Turing"
# Stage 1: full_name = first_name + " " + last_name
full_name = first_name + " " + last_name
print(full_name)

challenges.title: Stage 2: Dynamic Welcome Message
challenges.description: Create greeting <hlt>greeting = "Hello, " + full_name + "!"</hlt> and print it.
challenges.starter_code:
first_name = "Alan"
last_name = "Turing"
full_name = first_name + " " + last_name
# Stage 2: Create greeting
greeting = "Hello, " + full_name + "!"
print(greeting)
